meta.name: understand-onboard
meta.description: Use when you need to generate an onboarding guide for new team members joining a project

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为新成员生成项目入职指南
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要快速帮助新成员了解项目
copy.tagline_en: Generate onboarding guides for new team members
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs to quickly help new members get up to speed

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据项目的知识图谱生成一份新成员入职指南，包含项目概览、架构分层、关键概念、导览、文件地图和复杂度热点。
howto.when: 当用户要求为项目生成新成员入职指南时触发。

say.text: 请为这个项目生成一份新成员入职指南。
say.note: Claude 会读取知识图谱并生成指南。

say.text: 帮我生成项目的架构分层和文件地图。
say.note: Claude 会提取层和文件节点信息。

say.text: 列出项目中的复杂度热点。
say.note: Claude 会找出高复杂度文件节点。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate an onboarding guide for new team members from the project's knowledge graph, including project overview, architecture layers, key concepts, guided tour, file map, and complexity hotspots.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to generate an onboarding guide for new team members joining a project.

say_en.text: Generate an onboarding guide for this project.
say_en.note: Claude reads the knowledge graph and produces the guide.

say_en.text: Show me the architecture layers and file map.
say_en.note: Claude extracts layers and file nodes.

say_en.text: List the complexity hotspots in the project.
